consequence.statement: A promtail panic after reload caused by duplicate metric registration is fixed; no operator action is needed.

original.statement: Promtail no longer panics from duplicate metric registration after a reload (bugfix).

decision.reason: [ev-bbd391240669] lists this under 3.0.0 Bug Fixes. It says the change stops promtail from panicking on duplicate metric registration after a reload. Upgrading applies the fix with nothing else to do. The evidence does not say anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so "none" (informational) with low severity is supported.
